slots.title: Proposed French tax on regulated stablecoins could drive crypto traders offshore
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Chainalysis CEO in France Francois Volpoet warned the proposed 31.4% tax on regulated stablecoins could push traders toward unmonitored offshore channels.

slots.title: Coinbase, which holds 5% of all bitcoin, wants the quantum fix started now
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Coinbase says bitcoin should start preparing for quantum computers now, with flexible addresses, a backup quantum-proof key and a separate debate over lost coins.

slots.title: Fed’s Williams sees AI supply squeeze lasting beyond 2 years
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: New York Fed President John Williams’ comments came as he reaffirmed his view that the US Federal Reserve may need to raise interest rates once more this year.

slots.title: Cerebras CEO says we’re nearing a future where everyone has a personal AI assistant at home
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman predicts a future where personal AI assistants become as commonplace as household appliances, running partly on local devices and partly in the cloud.

slots.title: Standard Chartered unlocks direct bitcoin and ether trading for affluent UAE clients
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The bank manages custody and settlement in-house via a closed-loop model, removing the need for separate crypto wallets.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.title: Ripple adds Stripe-owned wallets to XRP Ledger as AI payments pass 14 million
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The integration will let software pay for online services using XRP and RLUSD, while questions remain about how much real economic activity the transactions represent.
slots.reason: Outside your usual reads — worth a skim
